heading: Add a card to finish
body: Both parties have signed. Save a card now — you won't be charged yet. The platform fee is charged automatically only once the collaboration is completed.

feeCard.title: Collabnb Platform Fee · charged at completion

errors.saveContractFirst: Please save the contract before adding a card.
errors.stripeNotConfigured: Stripe not configured. Run: npx convex env set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY sk_test_...
errors.checkoutFailed: Could not start checkout. Please try again.

achRequired.banner: This is a larger collaboration (${{amount}}+) — bank account (ACH) is required for collaborations of $300 or more. This keeps processing costs sustainable for the platform so we can keep fees low overall.
achRequired.optOut: I don't have a US bank account
achRequired.optedOutNote: No problem — you can pay with a card instead. Note this collaboration will cost the platform significantly more in processing fees.
